title: The pre-ready checks name a step with its job, so a suite that moved to another job still runs
why: Source: lane fast-checks-before-ready, draft PR #3397, round 1 FAIL on 7 fixable findings (the lane's read, relayed by the coordinator 04:35 CST Nov 14; neither the coordinator nor triage read it): #3376 moved the project-ops scaffold suite from job `checks` to job `checks-rest`; `bin/ci-job --step` reads one job, so the pre-ready run cannot run the scaffold suite and reads "unknown". Fix (a): job-qualified step names in merge.readyChecks (`checks-rest:<name>`). Touches ci-job and the merge tool, so a guard or check change: round 3 applies. Interim, the coordinator's: #3397 ships with five of six checks, the scaffold check printed as "unknown: not run". Lane's measured numbers (warm, 3 ready PRs; unchecked by triage): STE lint 0.8-3.3 s, split guard 5.6-6 s, cost pins 0.4 s, dry merge 1.1-1.7 s, clash 7.5-9.8 s (ready-only scope b), whole run 18-33 s. The lane found one real clash by merge-tree: #3274 against ready #3349; #3158 and #3180 conflict with main (refused in 0.4 s). The lane's open-PR count (567, its own message) looks off against the coordinator's reads of this repo: NOT filed as fact.
